title: trollius pumilus f. sikkimensis
intro: Trollius pumilus f. sikkimensis, commonly known as the Sikkim globeflower, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Ranunculaceae family. It is a perennial plant native to the Himalayas, and its flowers are known for their unique, globe-shaped appearance. Trollius pumilus f. sikkimensis has been used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, and its health benefits include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions include soothing and calming effects, while its bioactive constituents include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
